colors.brand marks: --brand-<slug> in icons.css (tesla #CC0000, nvidia #76B900, apple #111111, microsoft #0078D4, meta #0467DF, amazon #FF9900, google #4285F4, invesco #0A2240, vanguard #96151D, spdr #1F3A5F)

typography.display: var(--font-display) Sora 800, letter-spacing -0.02em; news lead 30/48px line-height 1.08
typography.mono: var(--font-mono) JetBrains Mono 9–12px uppercase, letter-spacing 0.14–0.22em for tags and meta
typography.jp: var(--font-jp) Noto Serif JP 700 for the page subtitle

shadows.rule: none on the wire; the app's one drop shadow is the receipt's (tokens.css)

motion.ease: var(--ease) cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) 150–200ms; hover translateX(2px) on rows; pulse only on the live dot; reduced-motion honoured

design.density: editorial: whitespace and hairlines do the layout; no card chrome on the wire

must: Masayume markup and classes stay exact where they exist (D-081); creative license only on new state and the flagged surfaces (/news, take card, composer)
Tokens only: no hex or px in TSX (design-literals invariant); values live in feature CSS with the source utility named
Vermilion is the only accent; sentiment uses --profit/--loss
Dark and light from the same rules ([data-theme=light] overrides)
Money in integer base units; no floats
avoid: images, gradients, heavy card shadows on the wire
Tailwind colour utilities or pasted HTML in final code

decisions.summary: Masayume exact where it exists; creative license on new/flagged surfaces in Masayume tokens
/news and the take card redesigned: sentiment-tinted edge, asset-mark chips + $TICKER cashtags, one shared .news-row grammar for /news, the activity feed and the ticker hub
Real asset marks (simple-icons, vendored) drawn on Masayume's 32-unit disc (AssetMarkSvg)
